note: The euro came into existence on 1 January 1999 and was first quoted on 4 January 1999, succeeding the ECU (XEU) at 1:1. Euro-denominated quotes dated earlier are the ECU.

The new manat replaced the old manat (AZM) at 5000:1 on 1 January 2006. CBAR's archive relabels old-manat bulletins as AZN (1 USD = 4593 on 2005-12-30, 0.9184 on 2006-01-03), and the Bank of Lithuania does the same. Quotes dated earlier are old manat.
